dialog.how_to_print.booklet_order_h: The pages look out of order
dialog.how_to_print.booklet_order_p: That's expected — the order only makes sense once the booklet is folded. It's correct if the first and last pages are together at the start and the middle pages are at the end. Blank pages at the start are also normal: they keep the pages paired correctly once opened.
dialog.how_to_print.booklet_thick_p: Reducing the font size, line height, and margins can help significantly. If you don't want to change the contents you can try using thinner paper (around 70gsm / 18lb). Worst case, consider breaking the document up into two different booklets or printing professionally.
dialog.how_to_print.booklet_upside_down_: The double-sided setting is flipping on the wrong edge. A landscape booklet must flip on the "short edge". If your printer won't let you choose "short edge", turn on the portrait workaround in this app's advanced options and generate the document again.
dialog.how_to_print.custom_spec_p: You entered the bleed and spine width by hand, so confirm they match your printer's specification for this size and binding.
dialog.how_to_print.generic_cover_p: Provide the cover as the separate cover PDF — it is already built as a single wraparound piece with the spine width and bleed for this document's page count.
dialog.how_to_print.generic_intro: Send the interior PDF — and the cover PDF, if you added a cover — to your printing service. Both can be downloaded from the buttons next to this one.
dialog.how_to_print.generic_match_p: Tell the printer the trim size, binding, paper and ink type shown for this version so their setup matches the file.
dialog.how_to_print.generic_noscale_p: Ask them to print at 100% with no scaling or "fit to page", and not to add their own margins. The PDF already includes the correct margins, binding gutter and bleed.
dialog.how_to_print.generic_proof_p: Ask for a physical proof and check it before committing to the full print run.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_color_h: What interior color should I choose?
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_color_p_1: If you are just printing text, select
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_color_p_3: (or premium if the cost isn't a concern).
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_cover_p: Upload the separate cover PDF — it is already built as a single wraparound with the spine width and bleed for this document's length.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_finish_h: Should my cover be glossy or matte?
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_finish_p_1: Both cost the same and suit different styles.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_finish_p_2: is more vibrant with a modern feel.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_finish_p_3: is more soft with an elegant feel.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_intro: Create your project on lulu.com and upload the interior PDF (and the cover PDF, if you added a cover). Both can be downloaded from the buttons next to this one.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_match_p: When setting up the Lulu project, choose the same trim size, binding, paper and ink type shown for this version. Lulu checks the file against these and rejects mismatches.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_noscale_p: The interior already includes the correct margins, binding gutter and bleed for its page count. Don't let Lulu scale or "fit" the pages.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_paper_h: What paper type should I choose?
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_paper_p_4: for a modern/clean feel. If you have pictures,
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_paper_p_5: can make them look better. It is more durable, has a slight sheen, but costs more.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_proof_p: Order a single proof copy and check it before ordering a full run.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_walk_1_body: Lulu is the simplest print-on-demand service and ships worldwide. Creating an account is simple and free.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_walk_2_body: Create a new project for each book. Product type should be "Print Book", and goal should be "Print Your Book" so you can print copies without actually publishing it publicly. The title and category isn't important.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_walk_3_body: Upload the interior PDF, which is the actual contents of your book. Lulu will auto-detect the size and page count from the PDF.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_walk_4_body: If you want to change it you'll need to change the binding option in this app first, as it affects the dimensions of generated PDFs. All the other options can be whatever you prefer.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_walk_5_body: Upload the separate cover PDF. As long as you chose the same binding in this app and in Lulu, then the cover should be the right size.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_walk_6_body: Continue with Lulu's steps to publish the book, which in this case merely means a private publishing that only you can order. Add a copy to your cart and proceed to checkout. We recommend ordering only a single copy initially, in case any defects are discovered after printing. Additional copies can be ordered after that if desired.
dialog.how_to_print.lulu_walk_6_title: 6. Publish the book and order a copy
dialog.how_to_print.one_sided_h: My printer can only print on one side
dialog.how_to_print.one_sided_p: You can still print double sided manually. In your printer settings choose to print only the odd pages, then flip the printed stack over and put it back in the tray to print the even pages on the blank sides. Flipping the whole stack usually works, but printers vary, so print a few test pages first.
dialog.how_to_print.plain_bind_p: Hole-punch the pages for a ring binder or folder, or take the printed stack to a copy shop for spiral or comb binding.
dialog.how_to_print.plain_double_sided_p: If you print double-sided, set it to flip on the "long edge" so the pages read the right way up.
dialog.how_to_print.plain_intro: This document prints as ordinary single pages at your chosen paper size.
dialog.how_to_print.plain_scale_p: In the print dialog choose "Actual size" or 100%, not "Fit to page" — scaling changes the margins and text size.
dialog.how_to_print.walk_1_body: The pages are landscape, so setting it to long edge would print half of them upside down.
dialog.how_to_print.walk_1_title: 1. Print double-sided, flip on short edge
dialog.how_to_print.walk_2_body: Printing the cover separately lets you print it in color, or use thicker paper if you prefer.
dialog.how_to_print.walk_3_body: Fold the sheets together with the cover, ensuring they are aligned before pressing down. Put pressure on the middle of the page when folding to ensure the sheets don't move out of place.
dialog.how_to_print.walk_4_body: You can do this with an ordinary stapler as long as it opens fully; simply staple into an eraser on the other side and fold the ends down. If you'll be making lots of booklets, consider buying a long-arm stapler, swing-arm stapler, or booklet stapler.
dialog.how_to_print.walk_5_body: If the booklet doesn't lie flat, leave something heavy on it for a few hours.
dialog.how_to_print.whole_bible_p: This app is best for printing portions of the Bible. A whole Bible would need to be printed professionally, and even then usually needs a printer that specialises in Bibles.

dialog.missing_translation.body1: We include freely-shareable translations in over 800 languages. If the one you want is missing, it is most likely a commercial translation whose owners do not permit it to be printed, whole or in part.
dialog.missing_translation.body2: Where possible we recommend choosing an openly-licensed translation instead. If you know of one that is openly licensed but not listed here, get in touch and we will look into adding it.
dialog.missing_translation.title: Can't find a translation?
dialog.peddlers.body1: We cannot include commercial translations as the owners do not wish for you to be able to print them, whole or in part. This unfortunately includes the most popular English translations, such as the NIV, ESV, NLT, etc.
dialog.peddlers.body2: We instead highly recommend the {bsb}, which has a translation style between the NIV and ESV, and is trustworthy and free to share.
dialog.peddlers.title: Commercial translations
dialog.print_service_warning.body: Automatically generated documents can still contain mistakes, so please check yours carefully before printing. We recommend ordering a single copy first, then more once you've confirmed it looks right.

editor.advanced.alt_image_side_note: Switch which side the image appears on from one passage to the next, rather than always the same side.
editor.advanced.auto_gutter_amount: Currently {amount}{unit} extra, for an estimated {pages} pages.
editor.advanced.auto_gutter_note: Adds additional inner margin in proportion to the page count. The more the pages, the harder it is to bend the book and read text near the spine.
editor.advanced.auto_gutter_unavailable: This is only available for known printing services. You can instead simply adjust the inner margin manually.
editor.advanced.big_text_note: It's not recommended to use this setting unless you have eyesight issues that require it.
editor.advanced.dedicate_pd: Dedicate your own content to the public domain
editor.advanced.design_link_note: This allows others to print additional copies of your design and/or customize it (they won't be able to modify your copy).
editor.advanced.design_link_warning: Disabling this will prevent people from sharing the design, printing additional copies, and using it in other useful ways. We do not recommend disabling it unless you are including material from third-parties that is not openly licensed.
editor.advanced.emphasis_note: Italicize questions and embolden exclamations in picture story passages, enlarged and colored.
editor.advanced.flip_edge: My printer doesn't allow "flip on short edge"
editor.advanced.flip_edge_note: If your printer can only flip on long edge (which is the default for double-sided portrait documents) then this setting will output a portrait PDF with alternating rotation which will look correct once printed double-sided.
editor.advanced.hyphenate_note: Break long words across lines with a hyphen where needed.
editor.advanced.image_painted: Painted (padded, with a painted brushstroke edge)
editor.advanced.images_note: Applies to every passage image in the document.
editor.advanced.pd_learn_more: Learn more about public domain dedication.
editor.advanced.pd_note: This ensures your creation will be able to be shared and printed by others without restriction.
editor.advanced.poetry_outdent: Skip initial indent in poetry books
editor.advanced.poetry_outdent_note: Skip the first level of indentation of poetry when the whole book is mostly poetry (Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah…). Reduces line wrapping and improves readability.
editor.advanced.running_disabled_note: Enable page numbers and/or book & chapter name under Features to configure these.
editor.advanced.story_grid: Grid of 4 images & passages per page
editor.advanced.text2_size_note: 100% matches the main translation's text size.
editor.advanced.titlepages_note: Applies to every title page in the document.

wizard.books.whole_bible_p: This app can produce it, but printing it is another story. The Bible is larger than most books, and would be very thick and heavy using standard printing services. Published bibles use thin paper which is only available for bulk orders. If you're new to this app, we recommend trying to print a single book of the Bible first.
